scope: Diffusion-internal stage-1 mask filter. Applied after upstream check_mask, before inpainting. Does not change shared QC.
derived_from: mask_probe_v2 on screw+thread_side (64 samples each: official, gs999, gs2999, gs4999). No held-out data used.

area_window.basis: support mask areas at 256x256 (computed per defect type from the frozen support list)

binarise: mean over RGB of samples_scaled > 0.8 (upstream rule, unchanged)
